name: DL44 Metal Pistol
description: The DL44 Metal Pistol, also stylized as the DL 44 Metal Pistol, was a type of blaster pistol used during the time of the Galactic Civil War between the Galactic Empire and the Alliance to Restore the Republic. It was a lighter version of the DL-44 XT, and was similar in design to the DL-44 heavy blaster pistol.
